per_view.notes: Slender tapered fuselage with forward hump and tall swept fin; four boxy nacelles hang under a swept wing. Only one gear strut with wheels visible mid-body, no distinct nose gear. No passenger window band on fuselage; a stray arrow-shaped part sits near the nose, hurting cohesion.

Nose is a sharp cone, not an ogive; small cockpit dome sits behind a blank nose bay with odd dark spikes atop. Wings render as flat trapezoidal boards drooping below the belly (no sweep/dihedral). Tail plane looks crossed/misshapen. One ball-shaped nacelle hangs near the cockpit, not under a wing. No window line visible; gear cluster visible under center wing.

Fuselage renders as a thin vertical rod, not a tube or visible cross-section. Nose is a white sphere with a grey disc, resembling a fan/turbine face rather than an ogive nose. Wings are disjointed dark slabs with a visible gap between inner/outer segments, asymmetric left-right. Small wheel-dot clusters suggest gear; no clear hump, windows, or tail shape.

Rear view shows two side-by-side dark trapezoidal slabs instead of a single tall vertical fin with splayed horizontal stabilizers; a thin unattached vertical rod sits above them. Four dark blob engines hang under dihedral wings. Central grey disc is ambiguous. Some gear legs/wheels visible beneath center and outboard. No windows or livery color scheme; flat monochrome dark shapes on white.

Slender tapered tube with conical nose reads as fuselage-like, but wing/tail panels are flat rectangles floating at inconsistent angles with visible gaps from the body, not swept or tapered. Only two small cylinders suggest engines, not four under wings. A sphere near the nose substitutes for the hump. No window lines. Overall reads as a rocket/satellite, not a 747.

Model resembles a missile/dart: sharp conical nose, slender tube, small dome bubble mid-body. Wing and tail panels are flat, disconnected, and floating away from the fuselage in an exploded-view arrangement. No engine nacelles visible. Black zigzag marks read as a logo, not windows.

Slender white tube tapers at both ends; tall dark tail fin with thin horizontal sliver. Two flat unswept navy rectangular slabs mid-body read as wings but lack sweep/taper/dihedral. Small dark angular cluster and dangling strut/wheel at nose, not underwing. No window band visible anywhere.

Slender tapered fuselage with pointed nose, small dome hump, one swept wing and swept vertical fin plus horizontal stabilizer visible. Underneath is a jumbled cluster of overlapping dark boxes (unclear engine count) and a single thin dangling strut/ball, not a 4-truck gear. No windows/doors. Two-tone gray/black, no livery accent.

Sharp conical nose (not ogive), small floating dome near front reads as crude hump. Dark jagged specks on fuselage don't form a window line. Only one dark cylinder visible near tail suggests one engine, not four. Thin-strut ball wheels, not multi-wheel bogies. Tail panels overlap ambiguously.
